LYCOGGGNWhqG.old: # Core formulas (hybrid-attention + MoE aware). Reused by run_llm_analysis and the
LYCOGGGNWhqG.new: # Core formulas（核心公式，兼顾 hybrid attention 与 MoE）。供 run_llm_analysis 和下面的

LYCOGGGNWhqG.old: # Gemma-4's full-attn layers use n_global_kv_heads/global_d_head if present;
LYCOGGGNWhqG.new: # 如果配置中提供 n_global_kv_heads/global_d_head，Gemma-4 的 full-attention 层会优先使用它们；

LYCOGGGNWhqG.old: # otherwise the full-attn layers use the same geometry as the rest.
LYCOGGGNWhqG.new: # 否则 full-attention 层与其他层使用相同的 KV 几何结构。

LYCOGGGNWhqG.old: # GiB added to KV cache per token once past any sliding window.
LYCOGGGNWhqG.new: # 超过 sliding window 后，每新增一个 Token 给 KV Cache 增加的 GiB。

LYCOGGGNWhqG.old: # FP16 (2 bytes) * 2 tensors (K, V) * n_full_attention_layers * KV channels.
LYCOGGGNWhqG.new: # FP16（2 bytes）× 2 个张量（K、V）× n_full_attention_layers × KV channels。

LYCOGGGNWhqG.old: # Full-attention layers grow linearly; sliding layers saturate at sliding_window;
LYCOGGGNWhqG.new: # full-attention 层随上下文线性增长；sliding 层增长到 sliding_window 后饱和；

LYCOGGGNWhqG.old: # linear-attention layers carry fixed state (approximated as 0 for sizing).
LYCOGGGNWhqG.new: # linear-attention 层只携带固定大小状态（容量估算时近似按 0 处理）。

LYCOGGGNWhqG.old: # MoE: weights use total (all experts resident); KV scales with concurrency.
LYCOGGGNWhqG.new: # MoE：权重按总参数量计算（所有 experts 常驻）；KV Cache 则随并发序列数扩张。
# 单 Token prefill 时间：(2 * P_B * 1e9 FLOPs) / (TFLOPS * 1e12) = (2 * P_B / TFLOPS) 毫秒。
# TPOT：(2 * P_B GB) / (bw GB/s) = 秒；再乘 1000 转为毫秒。
